book.name: Zân
book.title: Zân Zisasiyet yaŋaŋ Zânaŋ meluwaŋ mge.

content: Kasayaŋ Zisas met atawien
Zisasiyaŋ dundundu kegok dundumepme delaŋ zeme wati nin ndatime mka pem toti met Kidolon tu somti tu nembet daen olip mulup temaŋ matatanen ke mobenn.
Mulup keyet keŋan Zisasiyaŋ ninmak kan kataŋ ke meti maondaktemenn keyepmti Zudasiyaŋ mulup set ke nâme delaŋ zein.

Keyepmti ekŋenaŋ ke mepme Zudasiyaŋ meti zeme sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ma Palisi ekŋenaŋ an kasa kuku ma sesewat mkayelen an tipdakutum mee pi zemindeme Zudas Zisasiyaŋ ikŋaŋ nembaŋaŋ wati mamtan egaŋ ikŋaŋ ŋeŋaŋ bemti indatime ŋelip sage timti tambuyet taŋam koŋti koŋti piyaŋ Zisas wasâgât kopmâbien.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ am kasayaŋ koti kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ sambe mnamâseip e nâme delaŋ zeye keyepmti ekŋenaŋ takopme kopme egaŋ keeselak ekŋenmagen sokŋan meti pigok zeye,” In an pe kwiyet tatimalip?”
Zeme ekŋenaŋ zewien,” Nin Zisas Nasalet mkaengatnaŋ ek tatimatnup.” Zeme Zisasiyaŋ pigok zeye, “Ne toka kapi talap.”
Zeme ekŋenaŋ weŋin mepme tikande kande meti toindomâge.
Mme Zisasiyaŋ ewe indayaŋkwesiye, “In an pe kwiyet tatimalip?” Indayaŋkwesime zewien, “Nin Zisas Nasalet mkaengatnaŋ egat tatimatnup.”
Zeme Zisasiyaŋ pigok diindoye, “Neŋ pi talap,” tazeyap pe tatnâip ma yek? In neŋ tatnatimalip beme nembanne indondopiŋ; nen kwep natamti napmelit.
Sepem kegok sokbeme Zisasiyaŋ ekŋengat dunduyeen keyet penaŋaŋ sokbem katik beye, “Nemba akum namane maindadamuŋ mkwalap ekŋenmagengatnaŋ ŋenaŋ ku walege.”
Âpme Saimon Pitayaŋ Zisasiyepmti gembo pitakŋanen yuŋmamaŋge pi sakwep seŋkwati sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ egalen sisiliŋ nemba ŋen kwitnaŋ Malakas zeme ke ek wakŋaŋ penaset sâmpeme mege.
Kegok mme Zisasiyaŋ Pita pigok dunduye,” Geŋ gembondi sakwep mti mkaŋan wepe. Bienaŋ neŋ sindem temaŋ kapi titiyet zemneŋge pi alak geŋ naman bekek nesât tapmnik?”
Zisas wati Anas egalen mkaen mebien
Zemti tapme am ek wati kosât mebien ekŋenaŋ Zisas atamti betnaŋ tegaŋ zampemti wati mebien.
Ekŋenaŋ ŋeŋaŋ Kaipasiyet tatnaŋ Anas ekmagen wati mebien. Kaipas egaŋ nup kan keyet sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengat ŋeŋaŋin temaŋ mamayet ombempeme mamtan.
Kaipas an keyaŋ Zuda am ekŋengalen ondedagen tati zet kapigok zeye, “Zisasiyaŋ tapme nin nukŋaŋ temaŋ aikbanupgat nin ek kwep kumann gakime dolakŋaŋ mambanup.”
Pitayaŋ Zisas zemkandat peye

Saimon Pitamak notnaŋ kwep ŋenmak Zisas zet muluwen wati mepme mâti eksât mebun. Nemba ŋen ke sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengalen ŋeŋaŋin temaŋ keyaŋ egat nâmpein keyepmti Zisas wati egalen mka keŋan mopme mâti keyegak mowege.

Âpme Pitayaŋgut igak paset zupman baen tati notnaŋ mebun ke sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengalen ŋeŋaŋin temaŋ egaŋ nâmpein keyepmti egaŋ nâmtalati met imbi sekekek damuŋ keyet zeme nâmti Pita set kwalet peme keŋan kwapme imbi keyaŋ Pita sepemaŋ ekti yaŋkwesiye, “Geŋ kapi an kandayet nembaŋaŋ ŋen tagigap.” Yaŋkwesime Pitayaŋ yaŋti zeye, “Geŋ pe kwiyet tazenik ne pi ka yegat.”
Kegok zempemti mulup an ma kasa kuku an ekŋenaŋ tâgâyet mti tep bume zime bembuluŋti kât tapmambienen ke mot wanzaŋgum tati tep kât tapmaŋge.
Sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengalen ŋeŋaŋin temaŋaŋ Zisas yaŋkwesisi sambe tayaŋkwesimaŋge

Âpme sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengalen ŋeŋaŋin temaŋ keyaŋ Zisasiyet nembaŋane nin zigoset indatiye ma egaŋ zet ziboŋ zikat indammge pe zigok penaŋ manzein keboŋ keboŋ keyet yaŋaŋ nâsâgât tayaŋkwesimaŋge.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ pigok dunduye, “Neŋ am sambe ekŋengat tuŋguwinan ma Zuda am nnaŋgalen sesewat mka temanen ma am ondedakŋin tema temanen sosok belak zetn zemzikat mti mkawaŋ bemeban.
Âpme geŋ nâgât pi eneyet tatnayaŋkwesinik? Am sambe zet mandiindoma nâip ekŋen ke indayaŋkwesimane zet pe zigok mandiindoyap e ekŋenaŋ zeme nâmbak.”
Kegok zeme an tipdakutum damuŋ mti tapmambien ekŋenmagengatnaŋ ŋenaŋ bepalaksat naŋgumaŋ somti zeye, “Geŋ sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengalen ŋeŋaŋin temaŋ kapi zet keboŋ ke eneyet dundunik?”
Zeme Zisasiyaŋ an ke ekti pigok zeye, “Neŋ zet bekanaŋ ma pembenaŋ zeya ze yaŋaŋ weyaŋ zemane nâmti tapmaŋgut nowek. Geŋ belak kileŋ etaŋ eneyet nonik?”

Zeme Anasiyaŋ sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengalen ŋeŋaŋin mulupmaŋ temaŋ delaŋ zeme belak pemti mamtan keyepmti Zisas betnaŋ ewe zapeŋ ke tapme zempeme sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengalen ŋeŋaŋin alakŋaŋ tatnaŋ Kaipas ekmagen wati mebegat zemindeye.
Pitayaŋ Zisasiyet sek ŋen ewe ku nâmpeyap zeye
Âpme Pitayaŋ ewe tep ke kâpmambe tapme am notnaŋaŋ ekti yaŋkwesiwien, “Geŋ kapi pe an kandayet nembaŋane ekŋengat tuŋguwinaŋgatnaŋ ŋen geŋ kapi ma zem tatnânup?” Âpme egaŋ zeye, “Neŋ yek penaŋ.”
Zeme Pitayaŋ sâpe sâpe bumbu ŋeŋaŋgat mulup anaŋ ŋen wakŋaŋ sâmpeye keyet notnaŋaŋ ekti zeye, “Geŋ saŋenen ekmak ilinsakwep muluwen daen mamane gikman pi.”
Zeme Pitayaŋ yaŋti zeye, “Neŋ penaŋ egat ku nâyap.” Zeme zeme keyegak pepup apmaŋaŋ yaŋbemti kâkâkâââk kuye.
Zisas wati naman amobotnaŋ Pailetmagen mebien

Tambuyet pi Kaipasiyelen mkaen ke zet mulup mti tapmetnepeme msame watoti naman Loma amobotnaŋ Pailet Zelusalem mkaen matatan ekmagen wati meti ilin penaŋ amobotnaŋ Pailet egalen mkaen ku mobien. Ekŋenaŋ puk nâmti mbien, “Nin Aŋgalalaŋ Kendoyen tu meu niniyelen kan sokŋanik bein kapi egalen mkaen mopmann ŋep ku besem.” Kegok nâmti zupman baenak kot tabien.
Ekŋenaŋ wakoti belak tambaŋgumen baen tapme indikti Pailelaŋ mka keŋangatnan toti pigok indayaŋkwesiye, “In an ke pe yom zigok mme wati kotalip?”
Indayaŋkwesime ekŋenaŋ zewien, “An kapi bekanaŋ ku mnak ze nin wati geŋmagen kapi ku kobenek.”

Zeme amobotnaŋ Pailelaŋ pigok diindoye, “In ilinaŋgalen zii zelin tazin keyet kataŋ nâmtati zetnaŋ zemdelaŋ zempeit.” Zeme Zuda am ekŋenaŋ zewien, “Nin am ŋen zetnaŋ zemdelaŋ zemti kumann gakikiyet ku nâmndendeŋaŋ.”
Zuda am ekŋenaŋ kegok zemti Zisas Loma amobotnaŋgat betnan beme Zisasiyaŋ maneti bam tep palen nomti masasoknewep zeye zet ke penaŋ sokbeye.
Âpme Pailelaŋ mkaŋaŋ keŋan motati Zisas zemandame mopme pigok yaŋkwesiye,” Geŋ penaŋ Zuda am ekŋengalen Amobotnaŋ manze zemane nâmbi?”
Yaŋkwesime Zisasiyaŋ zeye, “Zet ke am notnaŋaŋ zeme nâmti zenik ma gitaŋgat keŋdaŋgalak nâmti tazenik?”
Zeme Pailelaŋ zeye, “Neŋ Zuda an keyepmti nâgât tatnayaŋkwesinik? Zet ke gitaŋgat amdine ma sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋdine ekŋenaŋ geŋ zigok mmane gikti gati nâlen pi kolo?”

Zeme Zisasiyaŋ zeye, “Wa neŋ Amobotnaŋ msat kapiyetnaŋ yek. Neŋ Amobotnaŋ kululuŋen gwaengatnaŋ. Neŋ msat kapiyelen Amobotnaŋ mambak ze neŋ aminne zemindema ekŋenaŋ nadamuŋ katikŋaŋ mtapme Zuda am ekŋenaŋ ŋep ku natamti kobiek.”

Zeme nâmti Pailelaŋ zeye, “Âpme geŋ Amobotnaŋ temaŋ ŋen geŋ bekapi?” Yaŋkwesime Zisasiyaŋ pigok zeye, “Giti zenik kemak! Neŋ zet penaŋ ŋotekŋaŋ kapi zemkawaŋ bembeyet nâmti msalen kapi toti am mamaen sokbewan. Am zet penaŋ ŋotekŋaŋ kapiyet yaŋaŋ manâmâtâlip ekŋenaŋ nâlen zetn manâip.”
Zeme Pailelaŋ nâmti pigok zeye, “Zet penaŋ ŋotekŋaŋ ke pe kwilekiyet nâmti tazenik?” Kegok zemti ewe tambaŋgumen toti Zuda am pigok diindoye, “Neŋ ankaŋgwayelen yomaŋ ŋen ku aigap.

Keyepmti neŋ ilinaŋgalen set tazin keyet kataŋ Aŋgalalaŋ Kendo kataŋ am mka katikŋanen tatatnaŋ an ŋen ilin zeme nâmpema zupman makwawezin keyet kataŋ zeme neŋ Zuda ilinaŋgalen Amobotnaŋin kapi belak zempema totogalen nâip?”
Âpme ekŋenaŋ kwizet ŋak ŋak temaŋ mti zewien, “Wa ek yek. Balabasiŋgut belak zempemane tolak!” Balabas egaŋ Loma gapman mtoindeme keyepmti ekŋenaŋ wati mka katikŋaŋ mepewien.
